about: Source-record fixes for 8 oxjobs, one change per entry (handoff/source-record-fixes-2026-11-03.py). Each entry: the fields it sets, `expect` = the registry's live value of each of those fields on 2026-11-03 plus identity guards, an optional source_oa_override row, the works it re-stamps (any location, incl. xpac, API 2026-11-03) and its after-check on the live API. The undo of an entry is the same entry with set and expect swapped (--undo).
checked: 2026-11-03: registry rows read through the openalex_sources foreign catalog; works counts from api.openalex.org

Forman Journal of Economic Studies is a no-fee Creative Commons journal but reads is_oa false. OA from 2022 (flip year 2021): CC BY on every Crossref DOI from 2022; before that the college sold print subscriptions and named no licence. The flags are what apply_oa_flags computes for this override (start year = flip + 1).
